[1/3] Cut the 0.4.0 release with one version source, --version and a changelog

impact_assessment.why: Version strings disagree across __init__.py, pyproject.toml and the CLI banner, and the large feature set since 0.3.0 has no release record.
impact_assessment.benefits: A single version source prevents drift, --version supports packaging and support, and a changelog makes the release legible.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CLI metadata and pyproject change; dependency: tomllib is unavailable on Python 3.10 so tests must not require it; concurrency: none; state: packaging metadata must match the runtime version exactly.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Export __version__ from the package, derive the banner and argparse version from it, assert pyproject parity in a test, and document the release in CHANGELOG.md.

[1/4] Add run allegiance with Syndicate contract and Street shop patron bonuses

impact_assessment.why: Faction standing is automatic; players cannot declare a patron or shape which faction their run advances, so the new ranks lack a role-play choice.
impact_assessment.benefits: Allegiance gives each run a faction identity, adds a meaningful start-of-run decision, and makes patron standing and economics diverge from a neutral run.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: engine/save/history gain an allegiance field and reset accepts one; dependency: none; concurrency: one run; state: old saves must default to none and patron bonuses must stack within existing caps.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Normalize unknown allegiances to none, apply patron bonuses only through central payout/shop/standing paths, persist the field, and cover neutral/Syndicate/Street behavior plus legacy saves.

[1/3] Add a 50 CR contract-board reroll across terminal, API and Web

impact_assessment.why: A job board can roll three unusable offers, forcing a wait or a bad contract with no paid escape; the market has no service for it.
impact_assessment.benefits: A priced reroll restores agency at the board, creates a small credit sink, and gives the Web card a meaningful action.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new engine/API/CLI action only, no schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: one board per run; state: failed rerolls must not charge and active contracts must not duplicate.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Refill into a candidate list before charging, preserve the old board on failure, exclude the active contract signature, and cover success, insufficient funds, terminal state and API paths.

[1/2] Abort career reset when the pre-reset backup cannot be written

impact_assessment.why: reset_career treats a failed backup write the same as no prior career, so a disk error can still delete the profile the backup was meant to protect.
impact_assessment.benefits: The destructive path now fails closed: a career is only removed after a verified backup exists, and the user is told why the reset stopped.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: reset CLI/API behavior around backup failure; dependency: none; concurrency: single-user; state: successful resets and empty-career resets must keep working.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Distinguish an absent career from a failed backup write, abort before deletion, return a clear error over the API, and cover the failure and success paths.
